title: Rust: Dependency Injection
description: Implement dependency injection using traits and generic parameters in Rust.

steps.title: Interface-Based DI
steps.description: Define a trait `Logger` with methods `info(&self, msg: &str)` and `error(&self, msg: &str)`. Create `ConsoleLogger` that prints to stdout. Create a `UserService` that takes `Box<dyn Logger>`.
hints: This decouples UserService from the logging implementation.

verification.failureMessage: Create a UserService with ConsoleLogger and perform an operation.

steps.title: Constructor Injection
steps.description: Create a `Database` trait with `fn query(&self, sql: &str) -> Vec<String>`. Create `PostgresDb` and `SqliteDb` implementations. Create a `UserRepository` that takes `Box<dyn Database>` in its constructor.
hints: `impl UserRepository { fn new(db: Box<dyn Database>) -> Self { Self { db } } }`

verification.failureMessage: Create UserRepository with database and run a query.

steps.title: Generic Parameter DI
steps.description: Use generic parameters instead of trait objects: `struct Service<T: Logger> { logger: T }`. This has zero runtime overhead. Test with `Service<ConsoleLogger>`.
hints: Generic DI is resolved at compile time (monomorphization).
No heap allocation or dynamic dispatch needed.

verification.failureMessage: Create Service<ConsoleLogger> and call its methods.

steps.title: Service Container
steps.description: Create a simple DI container `ServiceContainer` that stores services in a `HashMap<String, Box<dyn Any>>`. Add `set<T: Any + 'static>(&mut self, service: T)` and `get<T: Any + 'static>(&self) -> Option<&T>` methods.

verification.failureMessage: Register and retrieve a service from the container.

steps.title: Fully Wired Application
steps.description: Wire together Logger, Database, UserRepository, and UserService using constructor injection. Create a function `build_application() -> UserService` that assembles everything. Print the results of an operation.

verification.failureMessage: Wire all dependencies and perform a complete operation.
